issue: आपको दे दियो आशीर्वाद: read as a request (the context asks for blessing and a hand on the head), not 'gave a blessing to you'.
alternatives: '(We) have given you our homage/blessing' taken literally.

issue: पित्तरजी अंश उसी दृष्टि का: what 'that vision' is.
our reading: The ancestors are a part of that same vision (of Nārāyaṇa, the support of creation).
alternatives: 'a part of that same creation (सृष्टि)', if दृष्टि is a slip for सृष्टि.

issue: प्रथम पूजन प्रभु आज्ञा सुनाते: no subject named for सुनाते.
our reading: The Lord's command is proclaimed, that you be worshipped first.
alternatives: You (the ancestors) make known the Lord's command of first worship.

issue: पित्तर भाई: भाई as an address or 'as brothers'.
our reading: An address: '…all worship the ancestors, brother.'
